get.description:
Returns aggregated wallet intel (summary + HUD + behavior + PnL).

**HTTP 200 — status "ok":** Data returned immediately (or after synchronous wait). 5cr charged.
**HTTP 202 — status "queued":** Analysis timed out (>30s). 0cr charged. Poll `monitoringUrl` for completion, then call again with `X-Prepaid-Job-Id: {prepaidJobId}` header — no second payment required.
**HTTP 422 — status "skipped":** Known system/program wallet, not eligible for analysis. 0cr charged.

202.description: Analysis queued — poll monitoringUrl then call again

402.description: Insufficient credits or X402 payment required

422.description: Known system wallet — not eligible for analysis, 0cr charged

post.description:
Queues holder-profiles analysis for the top N holders of a token mint.

**Always returns HTTP 202** — the job runs asynchronously. Poll `monitoringUrl` for completion. Job result is stored in Redis under `holder-profiles:result:{jobId}` (15-min TTL), retrievable via `GET /api/v1/jobs/result/by-key`.

20cr deducted on job acceptance. No charge if the mint address is invalid (400).

202.description: Holder-profiles job accepted — poll monitoringUrl for completion

400.description: Invalid token mint address or topN out of range

402.description: Insufficient credits or X402 payment required

post.summary: Queue holder-profiles analysis for a token (20cr)

post.description:
Same analysis as POST /intel/token/:mint/holders, but the result is transformed for agent consumption:

- **Aggregate block first**: population-level signal (behavior distribution, supply concentration, fast-money %, clusterAlert) — an agent reads this to make a buy/skip decision without scanning individual profiles.
- **Slim per-holder profiles**: behavioral signals kept in full; `currentHoldings[]` replaced with `holdingsSummary` (totalPositions, percentValueInCurrentHoldings, top 5 holdings by SOL value); debug fields dropped.
- **Target size**: ~1–2k tokens for 20 holders vs ~10k+ for the full shape.

Returns HTTP 202. Poll `monitoringUrl`. Once completed, fetch `agentResultKey` via GET /api/v1/jobs/result/by-key?key={agentResultKey}.
The full developer result remains available at `resultKey`.

20cr deducted on job acceptance.

202.description: Holder-profiles agent job accepted — poll monitoringUrl, then fetch agentResultKey

400.description: Invalid token mint address or topN out of range

402.description: Insufficient credits or X402 payment required

get.description:
Reads the completed holder-profiles result for the given jobId, applies the agent transform, and returns the slim payload. Call after polling confirms the job is complete.

Result shape:
- `aggregate`: population-level signal (behavior distribution, supply concentration, fast-money %, clusterAlert)
- `profiles[]`: slim per-holder records with `holdingsSummary` instead of `currentHoldings[]`
- `metadata`: token mint + holder counts

404.description: Result not found or expired (TTL elapsed)

post.description:
Same analysis as POST /intel/wallets/similarity, but the result is transformed for agent consumption:

- **coordinationScore** (0–1): weighted average of top-pair capital scores — single number for quick agent decisions.
- **flaggedPairs**: pairs with capitalScore > 0.7 — direct suspicious coordination signal.
- **topOverlaps**: top 10 pairs sorted by capitalScore, with shared/unique token counts but no `sharedTokens[]` arrays.
- No `uniqueTokensPerWallet` map, no raw vector data.
- **Target size**: ~1–2k tokens for 20 wallets vs ~10k+ for the full shape.

Returns HTTP 202. Poll `monitoringUrl`. Once completed, fetch `agentResultKey` via GET /api/v1/jobs/result/by-key?key={agentResultKey}.

20cr deducted on job acceptance.

202.description: Similarity agent job accepted — poll monitoringUrl, then fetch agentResultKey

400.description: Invalid wallet list or invalid wallet address

402.description: Insufficient credits or X402 payment required

get.description:
Reads the completed similarity result for the given requestId, applies the agent transform, and returns the slim payload. Call after polling confirms the job is complete.

Result shape:
- `coordinationScore`: weighted average of top-pair scores (0–1)
- `flaggedPairs`: pairs above 0.7 threshold
- `topOverlaps`: top 10 pairs with token counts (no raw token arrays)
- `globalMetrics`: averageSimilarity
- `metadata`: wallet count + vector type

404.description: Result not found or expired (TTL elapsed)

post.description:
Queues a holder-profiles job for the token mint. Once holder-profiles completes, the processor automatically chains a similarity job using the discovered holder addresses — no round-trip needed.

Returns both `holderProfiles` and `similarity` identifiers upfront. Poll the holder-profiles job first, then poll `similarity.resultKey` until the similarity result appears.

35cr per call (vs 40cr for the manual two-step flow).

202.description: Holder-profiles + chained similarity queued — poll both result keys

400.description: Invalid mint address or topN out of range

402.description: Insufficient credits or X402 payment required

post.description:
Returns HUD metrics for each wallet. Missing or stale wallets are auto-queued for flash analysis.

**Response shape:**
- `huds`: map of address → HUD for wallets with fresh data
- `queued`: array of `{walletAddress, jobId, monitoringUrl}` for wallets that needed analysis
- `skipped`: known system/program wallets (no analysis possible)

5cr per call. Call again after queued jobs complete to get the remaining HUDs. Max 30 wallets.

200.description: Batch HUD — huds map + queued jobs + skipped list

400.description: Invalid request — empty array, >30 wallets, or invalid addresses

402.description: Insufficient credits or X402 payment required

post.summary: Batch HUD for up to 30 wallets (5cr)

signalType.description: Signal type identifier for this payload

trimmedMeanPnl.description: Trimmed mean PNL per token (outliers removed) in SOL

avgTxValueSol.description: Average transaction value in SOL (total SOL volume / total trades)

medianHoldTimeHours.description: Median hold time for completed trades in hours (more precise than category)

avgTradesPerDay.description: Average number of trades per day (note: UI displays uniqueTokensPerDay instead)

isWhale.description: Whale detection flag (true if portfolio value > 200 SOL OR > $20k USD)

uniqueTokensPerDay.description: Average unique tokens traded per day (for bot detection)

currentHoldingsSol.description: Total portfolio value in SOL (sum of all current token holdings value)

currentHoldingsUsd.description: Total portfolio value in USD (sum of all current token holdings value)

typicalEntryMcapUsd.description: Weighted median market cap at entry across eligible buy trades in USD

dominantEntryMcapBucket.description: Bucket with the highest share of buy-side USD deployment

calculatedAt.description: Timestamp when HUD data was calculated

totalAmountIn.description: Total amount of the token received (sum of 'in' transfers)

totalAmountOut.description: Total amount of the token sent (sum of 'out' transfers)

netAmountChange.description: Net change in token balance (totalAmountIn - totalAmountOut)

totalSolSpent.description: Gross SOL spent to acquire this token

totalSolReceived.description: Gross SOL received from selling this token

totalFeesPaidInSol.description: Total explicit SOL fees paid related to this token's transactions

netSolProfitLoss.description: Net profit or loss in SOL (totalPnlSol - totalFeesPaidInSol)

hasIncompleteHistory.description: True if FIFO history is incomplete (sells exceed available lots)

transferCountIn.description: Number of 'in' transfers for this token

transferCountOut.description: Number of 'out' transfers for this token

firstTransferTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the first transfer involving this token

lastTransferTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the last transfer involving this token

currentRawBalance.description: Current raw token balance (string to preserve precision)

currentUiBalanceString.description: Current UI-friendly token balance as a string

balanceDecimals.description: Decimals for the current balance fields

balanceFetchedAt.description: Timestamp when this specific token balance was part of a WalletState fetch

onchainImageUrl.description: Token image URL from onchain metadata

onchainWebsiteUrl.description: Token website URL from onchain metadata

onchainTwitterUrl.description: Token Twitter URL from onchain metadata

onchainTelegramUrl.description: Token Telegram URL from onchain metadata

pairCreatedAt.description: Unix timestamp when the trading pair was created

priceUsd.description: Current price in USD (string to preserve precision)

dexscreenerUpdatedAt.description: When DexScreener data was last updated

currentHoldingsValueUsd.description: Current value of holdings in USD (currentUiBalance * priceUsd)

currentHoldingsValueSol.description: Current value of holdings in SOL (currentHoldingsValueUsd / realTimeSolPrice)

unrealizedPnlUsd.description: Unrealized profit/loss in USD for current holdings

unrealizedPnlSol.description: Unrealized profit/loss in SOL for current holdings

totalPnlSol.description: Total P&L including both realized and unrealized (gross, excludes fees)

realizedPnlSol.description: Realized profit/loss in SOL from tokens already sold (gross, excludes fees)

realizedPnlPercentage.description: Realized P&L as percentage of total SOL invested (realizedPnlSol / totalSolSpent * 100, gross)

unrealizedPnlPercentage.description: Unrealized P&L as percentage of FIFO cost basis for current holdings

spamRiskLevel.description: Categorical spam risk level derived from token activity heuristics

spamRiskScore.description: Spam risk score between 0-100 (higher is riskier)

spamRiskReasons.description: List of reasons contributing to the spam risk score

spamPrimaryReason.description: Primary reason flagged for the spam risk score

hasActivityInPeriod.description: Whether this token had any trading activity (buy/sell) in the filtered time period. If no time filter is applied, this will be true for all tokens with transactions.
